column4: Every group trip starts here. And most of them end here too.
Who's booking? What's open? Is anyone even awake at seven?
So meet TripHive. One plan your whole group builds together.
Start a trip, share a six letter code, and everyone's on the same live plan. Each person sets their own pace and budget.
Then Hive checks the whole thing. Long transit legs, a skipped lunch, a sunrise trek nobody's awake for.
Need ideas? Just ask Hive in the group chat. It finds real places, and nothing changes until the group votes.
Costs split themselves. Weather, the PDF, it's all there.
Travelling solo? Find people headed your way, send a quick pitch, and join their trip.
From Bhutan to San Diego, trips are already taking shape.
TripHive. Plan together. Hive keeps it real.
